title: Trade desk action bar
description: The trade desk's sticky action bar (Offer nothing / Clear desk / Propose Deal, Accept / Refuse / Counter) now sits flush with the dialog's bottom edge, so no card or hint text shows below it. Each shot is scrolled to just short of the end of a long deal list.

shots.heading: Propose, desktop 1280x720, before
shots.caption: The bar stopped 2 px short of the padding, so the dialog's 24 px bottom padding stayed uncovered and card text continued below the buttons.

shots.heading: Propose, desktop 1280x720, after
shots.caption: The bar is flush with the dialog's bottom edge on an opaque panel background with a top divider and shadow; content slides under it. The capture script asserts the bar's bottom equals the container's bottom and the last card ends above the bar.

shots.heading: Propose, phone 390x844, before
shots.caption: A strip of the Quick deals list shows under the Propose / Offer nothing / Clear desk bar.

shots.heading: Propose, phone 390x844, after
shots.caption: Propose on its own row, the other two below it, extra bottom padding clears the floating Players / Events buttons, and nothing peeks below the bar.

shots.heading: Answer, desktop 1280x720, before
shots.caption: The answer screen's Accept / Refuse / Counter-offer bar on the base commit.

shots.heading: Answer, desktop 1280x720, after
shots.caption: Same screen with the flush bar.

shots.heading: Answer, phone 390x844, before
shots.caption: The answer screen on a phone on the base commit.

shots.heading: Answer, phone 390x844, after
shots.caption: Same screen with the flush bar.

notes.title: Before shots
notes.text: Captured on the base commit (unified-2026-10-08) with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before and committed as PNGs; npm run screenshots -- AL regenerates the after-* shots and runs the flushness assertions (propose, answer and counter prefill, desktop and phone).

notes.title: Fix
notes.text: Same approach as the production drawer's footer: negative bottom and margin-bottom equal to the dialog's padding (24 px, 12 px on phones) so the sticky bar reaches the container's bottom edge.
